meta_data.base_class: Fetch the value of a country's <monetary economic indicator> in a specific year - refers to high-level financial metrics expressed in currency units, used to evaluate national economic scale or financial status.

tool_template.name: finance.fetch_<class>
tool_template.description: Fetch the <class> of the given country in the given year.

country.description: The name of the country to get the <class> of.

year.description: The year to get the <class> of.

format.description: The format to return the data in. Options are 'JSON', 'XML', or 'CSV'.

include_historical_context.description: Whether to include historical context for the <class> of the given country.

adjust_for_inflation.description: Indicate if the <class> values should be adjusted for inflation for the given year.

data_source.description: Specify the data source to fetch the <class> from, e.g., 'World Bank' or 'IMF'.

confidence_interval.description: The desired confidence interval for the data retrieved for the <class>, e.g., 'high', 'medium', or 'low'.
